Method of Attack: Custom Cobalt Strike loaders planting persistent backdoors
DLL sideloading (WTSAPI32.dll) on legitimate app (wusa.exe) to run loader (chrome.inf) and inject Cobalt Strike in memory
Exploitation of PrintNighmare and PrintSpoofer for privilege escalation
Disabling security products by abusing vulnerable driver RTCore64.sys to modify kernel objects
Terminating specific running processes by patching access permissions in kernel space
Unregistering security products by removing kernel callback routines
Impacted Systems: Insurance and urban development firms in the Philippines
Aviation firms in Thailand and Taiwan
Attack Vector: Use of custom Cobalt Strike loaders with process injection and in-memory execution
Exploitation of PrintNighmare and PrintSpoofer vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: Use of custom Cobalt Strike loaders named Symatic and BigpipeLoader
Legitimate app wusa.exe used for DLL sideloading
